01 / THE COLLECTION

A Chum for every character.

Fomo Chumz is a collection of 8,888 NFTs on Robinhood Chain. Minting uses the CHUMZ token. Each NFT can be deposited into the collection’s staking contract to accrue funded CHUMZ rewards.

02 / MINTING

Approve. Mint. Meet your Chum.

  1. Connect a supported wallet and switch to Robinhood Chain.
  2. Choose your quantity. You need enough CHUMZ for the mint and ETH for network fees.
  3. Approve the exact CHUMZ payment if your allowance is insufficient.
  4. Confirm the mint transaction. The NFTs arrive in your connected wallet.

Transferring or staking NFTs does not reset the 100-mint limit. The limit counts lifetime mints by address, not the number of NFTs currently held. NFTs bought on a marketplace are also eligible for staking.

03 / TOKEN ALLOCATION

Every mint has two destinations.

70%

Burn allocation

14,000 CHUMZ per NFT.

30%

Staking rewards

6,000 CHUMZ per NFT.

The deployment will specify either native token burning, which reduces totalSupply, or a transfer to the dead address, which does not reduce totalSupply. The chosen mode is fixed after deployment.

If any payment, allocation or NFT mint step fails, the entire mint transaction reverts.

04 / STAKING REWARDS

30 CHUMZ an hour, per NFT.

Rewards are accounted for by the second. One staked NFT accrues 30 CHUMZ per hour, or 720 per day, provided enough unallocated funds are available. More staked NFTs multiply your rate.

The pool funds the rewards.

A single mint adds 6,000 CHUMZ, enough for one NFT to accrue rewards for 200 hours. Continued accrual requires funds from other mints or voluntary top-ups. The daily rate is not a guaranteed daily payout.

Once the unallocated pool is exhausted, new accrual pauses. Already-earned rewards remain reserved. Funding resumes future accrual only; it does not pay for time spent with an empty pool. Funds do not accrue to anyone while no NFTs are staked.

Anyone can top up the rewards pool by approving CHUMZ to the staking contract and calling fundRewards(amount). Top-ups are voluntary and cannot be reclaimed. A plain token transfer does not register a top-up.

05 / CLAIMING

Your personal 24-hour clock.

Your first claim becomes available 24 hours after your wallet’s first stake. A successful claim starts a new 24-hour cooldown. This is a per-wallet timer, not a shared calendar day.

  • Adding, withdrawing or restaking NFTs does not reset or shorten the timer.
  • You can wait longer than a day. Unclaimed earned rewards do not expire.
  • A failed or empty claim does not restart the timer.
  • Each NFT starts earning only when it is actually staked.
06 / UNSTAKING

No waiting to take your Chum home.

Select NFTs in the Staked tab and choose Unstake. Withdrawal stops future rewards for those NFTs, but preserves the rewards already earned by your wallet. Claim them separately once your timer allows it.

NFT withdrawal does not transfer CHUMZ, so a failing token payment cannot by itself prevent unstaking. Deposit through the Stake button; do not send NFTs directly to the staking address.

07 / WALLETS & NETWORK

Bring your wallet.

Connect a browser wallet such as MetaMask, Rabby, Coinbase Wallet, Trust Wallet, OKX, Phantom or Zerion when its Ethereum provider is available. WalletConnect supports QR pairing and compatible mobile wallets when configured.

Connecting a wallet does not authorize token transfers. Approvals, minting, staking, unstaking and claims require transaction confirmation. Your private key or recovery phrase is never requested by this site.

Token amounts use the token’s actual decimals. The NFT price, 70/30 allocation, maximum supply, wallet limit, reward rate and claim interval are fixed in the prepared contracts. The collection owner can open or close minting; the staking contract has no administrative withdrawal of the reward pool or tracked NFTs.

09 / COMMON QUESTIONS

A few things worth knowing.

Can I stake NFTs bought on OpenSea?

Yes. Any NFT from the configured Fomo Chumz collection can be staked by its current owner.

Why does my reward counter stop?

The pool may have no unallocated CHUMZ. Existing earned rewards remain reserved, and future accrual resumes after funding.

Can I claim after I withdraw every NFT?

Yes. Your earned CHUMZ remains associated with your wallet. The same 24-hour timer still applies.

Why isn’t my NFT appearing?

The indexer may be catching up. Use Find a Chum by NFT ID; the site checks ownership directly on-chain.
